decisions.reasoning: USDJPY.x closed at 157.8265 below the prior-12 low 157.8355, a 0.0090 breakdown equal to 0.063 ATR. Six-bar and 12-bar changes align at -0.2670 (-1.88 ATR) and -0.3075 (-2.16 ATR). Latest spread 0.003 is 0.75x the prior-12 median and 0.021 ATR, passing both liquidity limits. A SELL_STOP at 157.820 confirms below the completed close; stop 157.950 sits above the latest 157.9435 high, while target 157.580 remains just above the earlier 157.549 swing low. Entry risk is 0.130 and reward is 0.240, estimated 1.85R. EURUSD, AUDUSD and NZDUSD retain strong positive 12-bar changes, while USDCAD and USDCHF have negative 12-bar changes, confirming broad USD weakness even though JPY crosses are mixed. EURAUD remains a qualifying breakdown but may already be active from the prior alert, so it is not duplicated. EURGBP fails because spread is 0.153 ATR, above the 0.15 cap; GBPCAD fails at 0.230 ATR. Score 9/10: structure 2, momentum 2, entry 2, spread/liquidity 1, reward/risk 2, cross-market/exposure 0 because account exposure is unverified.
